# Firebrand Archer: "Whenever you cast a noncreature spell, this creature deals 1 damage to each opponent."
trig = TriggeredAbility(
    event=CastSpellEvent(
        filter=FNot(inner=FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.TYPE_EQ, string_value='Creature')),
        actor=FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.CONTROLLER_IS, who=ControllerRef.YOU),
    ),
    condition=None,
    effect=A(Verb.DEAL_DAMAGE, {
        'amount': QConst(value=1),
        'target': Selector(
            count=QUnbounded(),
            mode=SelectorMode.ALL,
            filter=FAnd(children=()),
            zones=(Zone(kind=ZoneKind.PLAYER, controller=ControllerRef.OPPONENT),),
        ),
    }),
)
abilities = [trig, *compiled]
